scope: Same native mapped512 plus 6GiB RAM cache and 3GiB reserve, with half-clean-file-LRU reclaim credit instead of inactive-only credit; all prior resource limits and native arguments unchanged. Traced regression, not formal paired performance.

native: A red apple on a wooden table, soft daylight, realistic photo.

measurement_change: Additional readonly memory.stat and native RSS/high-water snapshots every 0.5s; not allocator-complete or process-exit peak evidence.

policy_basis.basis: si_mem_available includes active and inactive file LRUs, retaining min(half of page cache, low watermark).
policy_basis.project_policy: Credit floor(half of clean file LRU bytes), limited by usage, non-shmem file, host MemAvailable and each finite cgroup ancestor. No slab, anonymous, unevictable or swap credit.
policy_basis.not_equivalent_to_kernel: cgroup estimate is deliberately more conservative for file credit and does not claim globally identical MemAvailable arithmetic.

unchanged_inference: same saved initial latent, prompt, 512x512, source32/64DiT slots, native Vector text, 8 Vulkan FP32 steps, CPU direct VAE
